name: El Paso Public Library volunteer program
what_you_do: Volunteer at the public library. The program page does not list the tasks. Apply through the link on the program page first.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older. Volunteers 17 and up must have a state-issued ID.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Click the link on the program page. It goes to the City of El Paso volunteer page on governmentjobs.com. Apply there.
notes: The program page does not say which library branches need teen help. Call the Main Library at (915) 212-READ to ask.
